--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,35 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
-
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate input arrays
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
+    # Check shape consistency
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+    # Compute total log probabilities along future horizon
+    total_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    total_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    total_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    # Compute margin: improvement of with-result over no-call
+    margin = total_with - total_no
+    keep_mask = margin > tau_filter
+    return keep_mask, margin
